Glossary

Stat definitions

Term Definition Scale
RatingAdjusted power rating from ridge regression. 0 = league average.0 = avg
MOVRaw average point differential per game.
SOSAverage adjusted rating of opponents played.0 = avg
rSOSAverage adjusted rating of remaining opponents.0 = avg
Proj WAverage final wins across 10,000 simulations of the real remaining schedule.
BPMBox Plus/Minus. Net points per 100 possessions above average. BPM 2.0 with position and role interpolation.+8 MVP · 0 avg · -2 replacement
OBPMOffensive component of BPM.+4 elite · 0 avg
DBPMDefensive component (BPM minus OBPM).+2 elite · 0 avg
VORPValue Over Replacement Player. Total value above a -2.0 BPM player, scaled by minutes.5+ MVP · 3+ All-Star
PosEstimated position 1-5 from box score shares. 1=PG, 5=C.
RoleOffensive role 1-5. 1=creator, 5=receiver.
